title: A Letter for the Orchard
author: I. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Tamsin Okonkwo, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
